reasoning_summary:
Accepted 34.8 (drop duplicated 'beside'), 34.21-22 (nomine back to its own line), 35.13 ('at what time'), 35.17-18 (est's 'has been' back to 17, both records), 44.19 (recepso as future perfect) and 33.2 (cinaede rendered plainly as 'catamite').
31.14: English kept, incoherent textual note replaced with a grammatical note.
32.4: original rendered illud twice; now 'if you bid, help that', illud taken with adiuvato (anticipating the ne-clause), the alternative given in note.
44.13: WRONG verdict upheld but the suggestion rejected: gravido is Merrill's spelling of the noun gravedo (nominative, cf. gravedinem line 19), so the line is 'here me a chill catarrh and frequent cough', not 'me, heavy'.
No disputes: every flagged record was faulty in the original and was revised.
